snippet.title: Full Circle Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
If fate was already written, would you still fight to change it? Full Circle is a JRPG inspired by the classics of the PS1 era, set in a world where humanity fled to the skies in an attempt to outrun their destiny. 

Solodeveloper 2ndPlayerGames and Deck13 Spotlight are proud to announce that Full Circle has finally been officially revealed. Expect more news in the near future and come to Gamescom where the game will be playable for the very first time. Or how some showcases would say: "World Premiere" (weird announcer Voice).

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439270/Full_Circle/
Twitter: https://x.com/2ndPlayerGames
